name: ボット整備
tagline: Keeps the labels on your other bots honest about what they now do
description: Bots drift: the name and the blurb describe the job they had on day one, not the one they have grown into. This one re-reads how each bot has actually been used, points out where its description no longer matches, and proposes wording that does. Nothing changes until you say yes.
author: x_stone_island
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
